title: Update previous employment Date of Exit

approved_steps.title: Review the previous employment record
approved_steps.canonical_guidance: Confirm that Date of Exit is missing for the previous employment record.

approved_steps.title: Follow the official Mark Exit process
approved_steps.canonical_guidance: EPFO provides a self-service Mark Exit process after the applicable 60-day condition is satisfied.
official_route: Enter Date of Exit and Reason of Exit

approved_steps.title: Wait for the official record update
approved_steps.canonical_guidance: ClaimSaathi is waiting for the trusted EPFO-style citizen state to reflect the correction.

approved_steps.title: Recheck trusted citizen state
approved_steps.canonical_guidance: Reload trusted CitizenState and verify whether the missing Date of Exit now exists.

success_condition: The unique PREVIOUS employment record has a non-null exit_date.
